mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS is below 5.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 4.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 4.0, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate a broad-based demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not negative in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a low-unemployment regime (UNRATE < 4.0%), a high federal funds rate signals monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when UNRATE < 4.0 and FEDFUNDS is above 5.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index indicates expanding economic activity, supporting corporate earnings and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when INDPRO is rising, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 1400.0 thousand units signals a contraction in the housing market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 1400.0, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous low employment levels and high unemployment rates indicate a weakening labor market, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not negative in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS is below 155000 and UNRATE is above 3.8, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 300.0), a high federal funds rate signals monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when CPIAUCSL > 300.0 and FEDFUNDS is above 5.0%, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
